_comment: O04 영어 씨앗 40장. 빈도 높은 어근·접사·업무 덩어리. 정의는 그 언어 안에서 쉬운 단어로(롱맨 방식, 기본 2,000어). 한국어 없음. kind: root | chunk. 순서 = 화면 순서.

items.definition: back, or to a time before now
items.example: a retrospective looks back at what happened
a preview is a look before the real thing
a postmortem is a meeting after something ended
to rebuild is to build again

items.definition: under, or a smaller part of
items.example: a subtask is a small task inside a task

items.definition: across, from one side to the other
items.example: to transfer is to move something across
an interface is where two things meet
to cooperate is to work together
to deprecate is to take something out of use
to inspect is to look at something closely
to export is to carry something out
to predict is to say what will happen before it does
a structure is something built
to reject is to throw something back
to produce is to lead something forward into being
to describe is to write down what something is like
a visual is something you can see
to submit is to send something in

items.definition: the act or result of doing something (makes a noun)
items.example: a decision is the result of deciding
readable means it can be read
to prioritize is to make something a priority

items.definition: the state of being (makes a noun)
items.example: clarity is the state of being clear

items.definition: to do the next thing after this, or check on it later
items.example: I'll follow up with the team tomorrow.

items.definition: to move a date later, or to say you do not agree
items.example: Can we push the deadline back a week?

items.definition: a short warning before something happens
items.example: Just a heads up, the demo moved to 3pm.

items.definition: to come back to a topic later
items.example: Let's circle back on this after lunch.

items.definition: to check so that something is certain
items.example: Make sure the backup ran before you deploy.

items.definition: when we think about this one part of it
items.example: In terms of cost, the second option is better.

items.definition: this is true based on what I know, but I am not fully sure
items.example: As far as I know, nobody has tested it yet.

items.definition: I think this is true, from what I can see
items.example: It seems like the API is slow today.
I'm sure you're busy, so I'll keep it short.

items.definition: I had a plan to do this (and maybe did not)
items.example: I was going to ask about that.

items.definition: here is the important point or the problem
items.example: The thing is, we don't have the data yet.

items.definition: imagine this is true, as an example
items.example: Let's say a user has no internet. What happens?
It's sort of working, but not for everyone.

items.definition: a small word to check the listener follows, or to find the next word
items.example: It's the, you know, the login screen.
I'd rather ship it Friday than rush it today.

items.definition: the answer changes with this thing
items.example: It depends on how many users we get.
Let's make sure we're on the same page before the meeting.

items.definition: to talk about it later, not in this meeting
items.example: Good question. Let's take it offline.
